title: Smiling Young Girl in Summer Garden, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from July 1962 featuring a cheerful young girl standing barefoot in a lush summer garden. She wears a patterned sleeveless top and dark shorts, posing standing among dense plants and large-leafed foliage. The photograph has scalloped deckle edges and a top margin timestamp reading 'JUL • 62', exemplifying mid-20th century American family backyard portraiture.
